note: Obiettivi aziendali proposti (procedura di risk management §2). Creati una sola volta per codice: modifiche ed eliminazioni fatte da Impostazioni non vengono sovrascritte.

objectives.name: Continuity of supply to OEM customers
objectives.description: Deliveries to OEM customers on the agreed dates and quantities. Threatened by production, system or logistics downtime beyond the BIA tolerance.

objectives.name: Protection of customer information and TISAX label
objectives.description: Drawings, specifications and prototypes entrusted by customers; keeping the TISAX label. Threatened by disclosure, theft or alteration of information.

objectives.name: Compliance with NIS2, GDPR and contractual obligations
objectives.description: Threatened by unmanaged or unreported incidents, unlawful processing and breaches of contract clauses.

objectives.name: Financial result
objectives.description: Threatened by recovery costs, penalties and loss of revenue.

objectives.name: Protection of people and the environment
objectives.description: Threatened by physical events and OT incidents with safety effects.

objectives.name: Reputation with customers, authorities and the market
objectives.description: Threatened by visible incidents or negative news.
